text:
Nora: FYI I ran the new reranker (v1.2-int8) through the cross-benchmark sweep and saw NDCG steady but MRR on the short-answer benchmark drops ~4%. Noticed this after merging the conversion tweaks.
Jin: interesting — which benchmark exactly? short-answer = the curated QA-short dataset or our web-short holdout?
Nora: QA-short (25k queries) + web-short (10k) both show MRR dip, QA-short worse. NDCG@10 stays within noise.
Priya: that suggests top-1 calibration shifted, not overall rank ordering. Any change in candidate generation or deduping?
Nora: candidate generation identical. I re-ran with the same candidate pool file.
Tomas: do we have per-query topk-logit diffs? int8 can compress margins so argmax flips but normalized rank metrics like NDCG less sensitive.
Nora: I exported deltas for top-3 logits on 500 random short queries. Median delta ~0.03 but heavy tail where delta ~0.15 causing swaps.
infra-bot: CI:rerank-crossbench-1711109999 started  logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1711109999
Jin: did the conversion script change layerwise scales? we recently switched to global-symmetric for speed. That could crush small margins.
Nora: conversion used global symmetric scales except final linear where we tried per-channel but maybe misapplied.
Priya: quick mitigation options: 1) run final head fp16 (hybrid), 2) recalibrate scale using L2 fit on a holdout, 3) apply a tiny temperature to softmax during scoring.
Tomas: hybrid is low-risk. But long-term, per-channel L2 fit is better. Also consider re-ranking with a small learned scalar rescale trained on a few thousand short queries.
Nora: tried hybrid on a subset: MRR recovered ~80% of the gap. Also ran a small learned-rescale (single param per model) on top of logits — recovered almost fully on QA-short but slightly overfitted on web-short.
Jin: overfitting could be dataset mismatch; QA-short has terser phrasing. We might need two rescale params or a simple calibration tree by query-length bucket.
Priya: can we add a short-query checkpoint in the GAUNTLET that runs both QA-short and web-short and enforces <1% MRR regression overall?
Nora: will file a GAUNTLET job. Also capturing detailed examples where top-1 flips for the triage doc.
Tomas: also check preprocessing differences: whitespace / punctuation normalization affects tokenization length. Short queries are fragile to that.
Nora: I diffed tokenization for a random subset — identical. But padding strategy changed in runtime from dynamic to static 16 -> might impact KV packing.
Jin: try eval with `--pad-to=64` and also `--pad-to=dynamic` to compare. If padding reduces flips, we can make pad a conversion config.
infra-bot: job queued: rerun-pad-variants-1711109999 on dedicated-gpu-2
Nora: results: pad-to-64 slightly improves MRR but not as much as hybrid. Combination (pad64 + hybrid) matches fp16 baseline.
Priya: good. For release: default to hybrid for production int8 until we fix per-channel calibration, and add pad-to-64 as opt-in. Also add a short-query smoke in pre-merge CI.
Jin: logging: add per-query topk logits and a flag when top-1 flips vs baseline so we can trace samples back to datastore and label quality.
Tomas: let's also add a small golden set of 2k short queries with human-eval references to track semantic regressions vs calibration.
Nora: I'll open PRs: 1) hybrid conversion wrapper, 2) pad config + eval variants, 3) gauntlet + golden-set. Linking tracker: https://tracker/redwood/ML-745
Priya: thanks. Could we surface a short note in the model catalog that v1.2-int8 has a short-query MRR caveat and hybrid is recommended?
Nora: yes will add catalog note and a migration doc for dedicated tenants.
Jin: nice triage. Follow-up: schedule a small offline study to re-fit per-channel scales using L2 vs KL and measure latency/regression tradeoff.
Tomas: +1. Assign me to the calibration experiment.
infra-bot: CI:rerank-crossbench-1711109999 completed with artifacts uploaded.
Nora: closing loop, thanks team. :thumbsup:
